خَوَقٌ Width (S, K) of a desert, and of a well, and of a vulva: (S:) or, of a desert, width of the interior: (JK:) or length, and breadth of expanse, and width of the interior: and of a well, depth and width. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And The mange, or scab, in camels: (El-Umawee, S, K:) or [a disease] like the mange or scab. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
